# TinyCompute

> A multi-provider compute marketplace via micropayments. No accounts. No API keys. Pay per minute.

TinyCompute provides programmatic access to three cloud providers — Fly.io, DigitalOcean, and Vercel — through a unified API. Payment is handled via MPP (Micropayment Protocol) using USDC. No signup required; attach a payment to your API call and go.

## Providers

- **Fly.io**: MicroVMs (machines), persistent volumes, app management, IP allocation
- **DigitalOcean**: Droplets (VMs) with power management
- **Vercel**: Projects, deployments, domain management (check availability, purchase, DNS)

## Authentication

All endpoints require an MPP credential in the Authorization header. Your wallet address is derived from the credential and used for resource ownership tracking.

## Pricing

| Action | Cost |
|--------|------|
| Create machine / droplet | $0.10 |
| Create Vercel project | $0.10 |
| Start / restart machine or droplet | $0.005/min (session) |
| Execute command | $0.01 |
| Create volume | $0.05 |
| Extend volume | $0.05 |
| Allocate IP | $0.01 |
| Check domain availability | $0.001 |
| Buy domain | Dynamic (market price) |
| Stop, destroy, list, status | Free |

## API Endpoints

### Fly.io Machines
- POST /api/machines — Create machine ($0.10)
- GET /api/machines — List my machines (free, wallet auth)
- GET /api/machines/:id — Get machine (free, ownership)
- POST /api/machines/:id/start — Start machine (session $0.005/min)
- POST /api/machines/:id/stop — Stop machine (free)
- POST /api/machines/:id/restart — Restart machine (session $0.005/min)
- DELETE /api/machines/:id — Destroy machine (free)
- POST /api/machines/:id/exec — Execute command ($0.01)
- POST /api/machines/:id/wait — Wait for state (free)
- GET /api/machines/:id/events — Machine events (free)
- POST /api/machines/:id/suspend — Suspend machine (free)
- GET /api/machines/:id/ps — List processes (free)
- GET /api/machines/:id/billing — Billing info (free)

### Fly.io Volumes
- POST /api/volumes — Create volume ($0.05)
- GET /api/volumes — List my volumes (free, wallet auth)
- GET /api/volumes/:id — Get volume (free, ownership)
- DELETE /api/volumes/:id — Delete volume (free)
- PUT /api/volumes/:id/extend — Extend volume ($0.05)

### Fly.io Apps
- POST /api/apps — Create app (free, wallet auth)
- DELETE /api/apps/:name — Delete app (free, wallet auth)
- GET /api/apps/:name/ips — List IPs (free, no auth)
- POST /api/apps/:name/ips — Allocate IP ($0.01)

### DigitalOcean Droplets
- POST /api/do/droplets — Create droplet ($0.10)
- GET /api/do/droplets — List my droplets (free, wallet auth)
- GET /api/do/droplets/:id — Get droplet (free, ownership)
- POST /api/do/droplets/:id/start — Power on droplet (session $0.005/min)
- POST /api/do/droplets/:id/stop — Power off droplet (free)
- DELETE /api/do/droplets/:id — Destroy droplet (free)

### Vercel Projects
- POST /api/vercel/projects — Create project ($0.10)
- GET /api/vercel/projects — List projects (free, wallet auth)

### Vercel Domains
- POST /api/vercel/domains/check — Check domain availability ($0.001)
- POST /api/vercel/domains/buy — Buy a domain (dynamic price)

## Health
- GET /health — Health check (free, no auth)
